TITLE: GALLERIA 2007
SUBTITLE: DISCOVERY IS ONLY THE BEGINNING
TITLE_HELP: A ACTION  B TORCH  A+B BACKPACK
INTRO_LINE:
BENEATH MONTE ECHIA, GEOLOGISTS
ARE AT WORK IN THE TUNNEL.
YOU ARE WITH THEM.
M_ROPE_KEY: WITH THE ROPE YOU RETRIEVE A KEY
D_PLASTER:
THE LIME HERE IS PALER AND
NEWER THAN THE REST.
DID SOMEONE CLOSE A PASSAGE?
D_DRAFT:
A THREAD OF COLD AIR SEEPS
FROM THE WEST WALL.
THERE IS EMPTY SPACE BEHIND.
D_FOOTPRINTS:
FRESH FOOTPRINTS IN THE DUST.
NOT THE GEOLOGISTS'.
THEY LEAD WEST.
D_MAP:
PROVISIONAL MAP (NOT A SURVEY)

ACCESS > TUNNEL > CISTERN
TUNNEL > GATE > VEHICLES
VEHICLES > SHELTER > ?
A0_BODY:
IN 1853 FERDINAND II OF BOURBON
ORDERED AN UNDERGROUND VIADUCT
BENEATH MONTE ECHIA, DESIGNED BY
ERRICO ALVINO: AN ESCAPE ROUTE AND
MILITARY LINK TO THE ROYAL PALACE.
A1_BODY:
THE TUNNEL CROSSES CISTERNS OF
NAPLES' MUCH OLDER AQUEDUCT.
THE POZZARI LOOKED AFTER THE
WATER, MOVING THROUGH WELLS
AND NARROW CHANNELS.
A2_BODY:
FROM 1939 TO 1945 BETWEEN 5,000
AND 10,000 NEAPOLITANS SHELTERED
HERE FROM THE BOMBING. LIGHTING,
SANITATION AND WHITEWASHED WALLS
WERE ADDED.
A3_BODY:
FROM THE POST-WAR YEARS TO 1970
THE TUNNEL WAS A MUNICIPAL
JUDICIAL DEPOSIT FOR OBJECTS
RECOVERED FROM THE RUBBLE. OLD
CARS AND MOTORCYCLES REMAIN.
A4_BODY:
IN 2007 GEOLOGISTS FOUND A
WALLED-UP PASSAGE LEADING TO
ANOTHER LARGE CAVITY, ALSO
ADAPTED AS A WARTIME SHELTER.
A5_BODY:
THEY ALSO FOUND A 17TH-CENTURY
POZZARI ACCESS: A NARROW
STAIRCASE OF 75 STEPS UP TO
VICO DEL GROTTONE.
(THE GAME SHORTENS THE STAIRS)
A6_BODY:
THE LAMP MAN, THE FOOTPRINTS AND
THE REWORKED PLASTER ARE GAME
INVENTIONS, NOT HISTORICAL
FACTS. THE MAP IS A PROVISIONAL
RECONSTRUCTION.
C_BACK: BACK TO THE LAST SAFE POINT
INFO_BODY:
THE GALLERIA BORBONICA IS A REAL
PLACE IN NAPLES AND CAN BE
VISITED.

THIS GAME IS INSPIRED BY ITS
HISTORY: THE REAL VISIT IS MORE.

OFFICIAL INFO AND LINKS: AWAITING
APPROVAL BY THE SITE MANAGERS.
